source_citation: Bui and Feng, doi:10.25919/myac-yx60, collection v3; Feng et al.2025, doi:10.1029/2025JC022662
mean_operator: Equal-weight finite daily paired velocity values pooled by calendar month or declared two-month phase, then locate the mean-profile zero crossing. This is not the mean of daily boundary depths or an equal-year mean.
boundary_operator: Start at the most negative finite mean along-current velocity in the declared upper-ocean core search interval. Traverse adjacent deeper negative levels. Use the first adjacent negative-to-nonnegative crossing, with linear interpolation within its depth bracket. A gap interrupts the trace; a negative deepest level yields only a censored reach. Do not jump to a deeper poleward return flow.
comparison_policy: Compare two-month estimates with published February–March350m and August–September260m only as checks of a separately declared OSW calculation. The paper's exact processing and published profiles are not assumed reproduced.
uncertainty_policy: A 5m sampling bracket and 10m display rounding are not physical uncertainty or a confidence interval. Observed-only sensitivity is not an uncertainty bound. Monthly extrema, if complete, describe this local mean-profile series only.
